strategyHelp.json_api: A documented public endpoint returning jobs as data. Config: url, items_path, fields.
strategyHelp.rss: An RSS or Atom feed of jobs. Config: url, title_pattern, and optional company / location fields.
strategyHelp.json_ld: Detail pages carrying schema.org JobPosting data. Config: listing_url, detail_link_selector.
strategyHelp.embedded_json: Jobs inside a page script such as __NEXT_DATA__. Config: url, items_path, fields.
strategyHelp.html_selectors: CSS selectors on the listing page, with adaptive relocation when the layout drifts. Config: url, item, fields.
strategyHelp.browser: Like page selectors, after rendering the page in a headless browser. Needs browser rendering allowed.
strategyHelp.ai: Page text is read by the AI fallback; used only with AI extraction on and within the budget. Config: url.
strategyHelp.none: The board is listed but never fetched.

errors.operatorOnly: Only catalog operators can do this.

diagnostics.challenge: The site shows a bot challenge to honest crawlers. Pilih never bypasses it; an operator can retry later or disable the source.
diagnostics.denied: The site refused access to our crawler. Pilih stops instead of trying harder; an operator can retry later or disable the source.
diagnostics.auth: Listings need an account on the site. Pilih never signs in or collects passwords, so this board is not scraped.
diagnostics.robots: The site's robots.txt does not allow crawling the listings, so Pilih leaves them alone.
diagnostics.rate_limited: The site asked us to slow down. The next check waits until it allows one.
diagnostics.rate_limitedUntil: The site asked us to slow down. The next check waits until {at}.
diagnostics.layout: The page layout or data format changed and no jobs could be read. An operator can update the strategy configuration and retry.
diagnostics.engine: Our scraper could not be reached. The run is retried automatically.
diagnostics.config: The strategy configuration is invalid. An operator needs to fix it.
diagnostics.transient: A temporary network or server problem. The run is retried automatically with a growing delay.
diagnostics.gone: The listing page no longer exists. The board may have moved or closed.
diagnostics.policy: This source is not allowed by Pilih's discovery rules.
diagnostics.other: The last run did not finish. Look at its log below.

pipeline.off: Boards are not being checked right now. Following still works; new jobs arrive once it is turned on.
pipeline.offOperator: Boards are not being checked. Turn on the {flag} feature flag to start the hourly runs.

directory.queued: Directory refresh queued. New boards show up after they are checked.
directory.failed: Couldn't queue the directory refresh. Try again.

retry.title: Retry {name}?
retry.body: This clears the failure count, closes the breaker and lifts a blocked, login or rate-limit stop, then queues a check. If the site still refuses honest crawlers, it stops again.

editor.title: Operator settings
editor.intro: Changes apply to everyone following this board and are kept when the directory is refreshed.

editor.aiHelp: Only when deterministic extraction finds nothing, with AI on globally and within the monthly budget.
